relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: SNL significantly increased the neuronal excitability and reset the excitatory/inhibitory (E/I) synaptic inputs ratio of aPVT neurons in mice

relationships.subject: GABAA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: pharmacological activation of the GABA<sub>A</sub> receptor at aPVT could effective relieve SNL-induced mechanical allodynia in mice

key_findings: SNL increases aPVT neuronal excitability and disrupts E/I synaptic balance; GABAA activation in aPVT relieves allodynia.
